gloss: outside the venue; out of bounds; off the field

definitions.gloss: outside the venue; out of bounds; off the field
definitions.explanation: The area outside the designated playing field, arena, or venue. Used in sports (especially sumo and martial arts), events, and figuratively for actions that go beyond the expected scope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{場外|じょうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The sumo wrestler went out of the ring.

examples.japanese: {場外|じょうがい}⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: He hit a home run out of the stadium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{場外|じょうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}かせた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: The match spilled outside the ring, surprising the spectators.

notes:
The opposite of {場内|じょうない} (inside the venue). Frequently used in sumo, wrestling, and martial arts where going outside the ring results in a loss. Also used figuratively for things that happen "off-stage" or outside the expected arena.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {場外|じょうがい}⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧: home run out of the stadium
- {場外|じょうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out of the ring/field
- {場外|じょうがい}⟦{乱闘|らんとう}→乱闘：21235_rantou⟧: brawl outside the ring
- {場外|じょうがい}⟦{馬券|ばけん}→馬券：22321_baken⟧⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: off-track betting parlor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {場内|じょうない}: inside the venue — the opposite term
- ⟦{圏外|けんがい}→圏外：07689_kengai⟧: out of range — used for phone signals or broader areas of influence
- ⟦{範囲外|はんいがい}→範囲外：28213_hanigai⟧: outside the scope — more abstract, used for limits of authority or discussion
